item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil ba rin chen gter mdzod kyi rgyud las man ngag dug gi spu gri 'bar ba
item.coloph: khod spungs mdzad srol 'od ldan dngos grub lags/ mi 'gyur gsang sngags grags pa'i bon skal yin/ 'dod phyogs can la u ya dam ma nyams/ gang thod 'chol tshe srog gi gshed du phob/ g.yung drung bon bstan srung ba'i mtshon char gyur/ nyi zer ci bzhin dar rgyas 'phel bar smon bkra shis//
